Namotu Island Resort.

Namotu Island is Fiji’s world class destination for water and sports experiences with easy access to Fiji’s premiere surf breaks. Beau in conjunction with Pepper Productions has produced many different videos promoting the island and services. Although an amazing island in a beautiful setting it is a difficult environment to shoot in due to dealing with the elements. Shooting from the water, in the water, land based and with drones the equipment gets abused.

Fiji Dentist Documentary.

The Fiji Dentist Documentary has been a massive production from start to finish. Our Pepper crew spent two weeks in Fiji capturing the group of American dentists as they gave up their time to help with the dental and medical needs in a remote part of Fiji. Follow their journey and discover how their whole operation runs.

Namotu Cobolt Promo.

Namotu Cobolt Promotional Video:

The Namotu Cobolt is the islands brand new Charter fishing boat.

The 320CC World Cat was brought over to Fiji in 2019 and for its release we flew our Photographer/videographer Beau to capture this beast in action. We were in charge of creating a short promo showing what the Cobalt is made of!

Watch

Namotu Fishing Adventures.

The Namotu fishing adventures follows the story of Ben Wilson from Namotu, Pro Surfer Adam Melling and Dyllon Schulz in their never-ending quest to find the ultimate fishing spots in Fiji.

Based out of Namotu Island, the trio spent 4 full days out on the boat hunting a huge variety of species.
